moat_against: Single-industry concentration in P&C insurance after energy/financial-services divestitures
AI disruption risk: insurer in-house AI builds and analyst scrutiny of organic growth
Transactional revenue is weather/claims-cyclical (-4.2% OCC in Q2 2026)
Growth decelerated to mid-single digits; FY2026 revenue guided $3.19-3.24B
moat_for: Proprietary industry-contributed P&C datasets built over 50+ years, not replicable by entrants
ISO rating/forms and regulatory filing infrastructure embedded in insurer compliance workflows
Xactimate embedded in claims workflows; serves the top 100 US P&C providers
83% recurring subscription revenue with demonstrated price realization on renewals
Asset-light high-margin model (~56%+ adj. EBITDA margin) funding aggressive buybacks
moat_justification: 50+ years of proprietary, industry-contributed P&C insurance data carriers cannot replicate, ISO rating/forms and 2,000+ regulatory filings a year embedded in industry compliance plumbing, Xactimate embedded in claims workflows, 83% recurring subscription revenue with proven renewal pricing power, and ~56%+ adjusted EBITDA margins. Held below 9-10 by single-industry (P&C insurance) concentration after divestitures and live AI-disruption scrutiny.
name: Verisk Analytics, Inc.
one_liner: Elite insurance-data franchise, moat 8/10, but priced for perfection — weighted IRR 10.3% (IV@15 $109.46 vs $190.42) clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$109.
